data.headline: UHS Q3 Deep Dive: Acute Care Growth and Outpatient Expansion Shape Outlook
data.summary: Hospital management company Universal Health Services (NYSE:UHS) reported revenue ahead of Wall Street’s expectations in Q3 CY2025, with sales up 13.4% year on year to $4.50 billion. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $17.38 billion at the midpoint came in 0.8% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $5.69 per share was 14.9% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
